verdict.rationale: The SoS documents a User Access mechanism that lets the entity control who may submit online filings on its behalf. From August 1, 2026 it becomes mandatory for Statement of Information filings, framed as preventing unauthorized submissions. That establishes a published delegation concept, but the evidence gives no detail on its scope. Missing for 10: published authorization forms for third-party agents, defined roles or permission levels, a statement of which signatures or attestations must stay personal versus delegable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
